package.description: Tiny Windows keep-awake tray app with polite mouse nudges and caffeine mode.

en-US.description: Tiny Windows keep-awake tray app with polite mouse nudges and caffeine mode.
en-US.longDescription: NudgeMug is a tiny Windows tray app for finite keep-awake sessions. It can use visible mouse nudges plus a harmless F15 key signal, or a quieter caffeine mode that keeps the system and display awake without user input.
en-US.name: NudgeMug
